title: TypeScript Generics
description: Master generic types, generic constraints, and build reusable, type-safe components and utilities.

data.text: Generics enable reusable components that work with multiple types while maintaining type safety. Use constraints to limit acceptable types.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Generics work with multiple types while maintaining type safety
Constraints limit acceptable types with extends
Default type parameters provide sensible defaults
data.takeaway: Generics are TypeScript's most powerful feature for building reusable, type-safe code. Master them to build flexible APIs and component libraries.
